instruction: Bring back the tab that was just removed from the browser.

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to reopen the last closed tab (reddit.com) using Ctrl+Shift+T. Evaluator verifies all 3 developer/community websites are present in open tabs.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts all open tabs from Chrome via CDP
Metric correctly compares actual tab URLs against expected URLs (GitHub, StackOverflow, Reddit)
Complete coverage: verifies the core requirement that Reddit tab is restored by checking all 3 tabs are present
Data flow is semantically correct: get_open_tabs_info returns list of tab dicts -> is_expected_tabs extracts URLs -> compares with expected
No timing/state issues: tab state is stable after user actions complete, no postconfig needed
Expected values are correct: the 3 URLs match the setup config and represent the desired end state
